title: docs(adr): ADR-0150 addendum says the renamedFrom holder carry also runs after each announced reload
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5wpk1gsxYNKAkG5qioWPNY)_

Fixes #33301

PR 2 of 2 for the card. PR 1 (#33478, merged) brought the `PositionSchema.renamedFrom` text, its liveness evidence and the plugin-security comments in line with PR #33245. This one changes only `docs/adr/**` (Tier H), so it waits for a GOVERNED_APPROVER.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只改 ADR-0150 第 288 行 2026-11-13 补遗中关于运行时机的两句及“启动日志”一句：职位改名持有人迁移不再“只在启动时”运行，还会在启动后每次 `metadata:reloaded` 时，只为通告点名的包或职位运行。补遗其它句子与裁决文字不动。
- **为什么改**：#33245 合入后原句已不实，评审 6879548824 与 6880449445 均要求以单独的 Tier H 文档 PR 修正。
- **风险与回滚**：纯文档，无代码、无发布内容。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md` 第 288 行。
- **两分钟验证**：`git grep -n "It runs at boot only" docs/adr`，预期无命中；第 288 行与 `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` 的 "When it runs" 一节说法一致。
- **需要你做的**：审阅并批准（Tier H，需 GOVERNED_APPROVER 批准后由席位落地）。

## What changes

`docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md` ~:288, the 2026-11-13 addendum (ruling A1, record 6841971722). Three sentences, no other sentence of the addendum and no ruling text:

1. FROM "and at `kernel:bootstrapped` the platform moves that position's holders" TO "and at `kernel:bootstrapped`, and again on each later `metadata:reloaded` that names the position or its package as registered, the platform moves that position's holders".
2. FROM "It runs at boot only: a package installed or upgraded into a running kernel is carried at the next restart." TO "It runs at boot over every claim, and on each `metadata:reloaded` after the boot over the claims of what the announcement names as registered (`app/ID` while the registry holds package `ID`, `position/NAME`): a hot install-local install, the runtime `POST /packages` install, a `PATCH /packages/:id/enable` that switches a disabled package on, a per-item publish of a position and the positions of a publish-drafts are carried at once; a hot upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves and an artifact reload that names only its file are carried at the next restart."
3. FROM "Every other stored reference to an old name is named in the boot log and never rewritten" TO "Every other stored reference to an old name is named in the log of the run (at boot for every old name it carries, after a reload for the old names it moved rows of) and never rewritten" (contract review 6886866329 nit; `readLeftBehind` with `leftBehindOnlyWhenMoved` on a reload run).

The facts are read from `positionRenameReloadScope` and the `metadata:reloaded` announcers on `main`, which since #33448 include the runtime install door (`announcePackageReload`, both answers) and the enable door (only when the package was disabled before). Round 2 answers contract review 6886866329 (FAIL at `99ff68df`): PR 1 listed those two doors as not announcing, true at its base `19cc8976`, false since #33448 merged; that text on `main` is corrected by a separate follow-up PR (Refs #33301).

## Tests

None: a docs-only diff.

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: no published package's `files[]` names `docs/adr` (every non-private `package.json` read), so the diff ships nothing.
